START_CLIENT.description: Whether to start the mlat client (yes/no)

INPUT_HOSTPORT.description: Host and port of the input receiver (e.g., 127.0.0.1:30005)

INPUT_TYPE.description: Type of input receiver (e.g., dump1090, readsb)

SERVER_HOSTPORT.description: Host and port of the MLAT server (e.g., mlat.adsb.fi:31001)

ALT.description: Altitude of the receiver station in meters

RESULTS.description: List of result servers to connect to (e.g., mlat.adsb.fi:31001)

LOGFILE.description: Log file path for the daemon output

RUN_AS_USER.description: User to run the mlat client daemon as

EXTRA_ARGS.description: Additional command line arguments for the mlat client
